extractedFrom: Newly written — no empirical original (the react-vite pack was a format reference only, with a content firewall)

exampleDomain.note: Every pack and seam uses the same example domain. The L0 contract passes this value to the seam and the gate's --pair checks it — this repairs the measured defect where the frontend called /tasks while the backend served /notes

fixesVariantsNote: The router is not a variant, since vue-router is effectively the only one. What varies is state management (Vuex still lingering) and the server cache
